app.name: RAWA | ThrombiX
app.tagline: AI-guided wearable system for early thrombosis prediction — research prototype

notice.demo: DEMO DATA — SYNTHETIC PATIENTS — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE

common.name: Name

landing.heroTitle: Early thrombosis monitoring, connected end to end
landing.heroText: RAWA | ThrombiX demonstrates how a wearable can stream biomarker and vital-sign data to an AI risk module, a patient app and a clinician dashboard — using synthetic data only.
landing.cap1d: D-dimer, TAT, soluble P-selectin and hs-CRP time series from a simulated wearable.
landing.cap2d: Low risk, rising activity, pre-thrombotic state and critical risk — from a labelled demonstration rule.
landing.cap3d: Intervention proposals are simulated only and always need explicit human confirmation.
landing.cap4d: Patient app and doctor dashboard read the same backend records.
landing.doctorText: Patients, charts, alerts, clinical review and simulation controls.
landing.patientText: A mobile-first view of one patient's own monitoring data.
landing.limit1: All patients and readings are synthetic.
landing.limit2: Risk categories come from a demonstration rule, not a trained or validated model.
landing.limit3: The Electrochemical Aptasensor is a conceptual, simulated sensor.
landing.limit4: No medication is administered and no dose is calculated.

risk.title: Simulated risk classification

explain.low_risk: No coagulation marker shows a marked rise in the recent window (demonstration rule).
explain.rising_activity: At least one coagulation marker is rising in the recent window (demonstration rule).
explain.pre_thrombotic_state: Several coagulation markers are rising together (demonstration rule).
explain.critical_thrombosis_risk: Several coagulation markers are rising strongly together (demonstration rule).
explain.insufficient: There is not enough reliable data to classify.

a.categories: The four demo categories are: Low risk, Rising activity, Pre-thrombotic state and Critical thrombosis risk. They describe how coagulation-related markers change over time in this demonstration. They are not a diagnosis.
a.latest: Your most recent stored readings: {summary}. Values are simulated demo data. Your care team interprets them, not this app.
a.latestEmpty: There are no stored readings for you yet.
a.lastUpdate: Your data was last updated {time} ({relative}). Updates are simulated.
a.lastUpdateNone: No update has been recorded yet.
a.hscrp: hs-CRP (High-Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein) is an inflammatory marker. Here it is shown for context only. It cannot show on its own whether a clot is forming.
a.risk: Your current demo classification is “{category}” ({origin}). It is generated by a demonstration rule, not a trained or validated model, and is not a diagnosis.
a.riskNone: No classification is available yet, or there is not enough reliable data.
a.features: You can see your latest biomarker and vital-sign readings, their history, your notifications, and change the language and notification settings. Ask your clinician about anything medical.
a.medication: I can’t give medication or dose advice, and this app never administers treatment. Please speak with your doctor.
a.emergency: If this may be an emergency, contact local emergency services or a clinician now. This app cannot provide urgent help.
a.notDoctor: I am not a doctor and cannot diagnose. Please talk to a qualified clinician about your health.
a.fallback: I don’t have an answer for that. Try one of the suggested questions, or ask your clinician.
